semiconductor_relevance: High — Sanying Precision Instruments manufactures X-ray CT scan equipment that is applicable in semiconductor inspection and measurement processes.
summary: Sanying Precision Instruments Co., Ltd. specializes in the manufacturing of X-ray CT scan equipment, providing a comprehensive range of products for inspection and measurement in the semiconductor industry. The company emphasizes R&D and has developed proprietary technologies to enhance its offerings, catering to various sectors including semiconductor manufacturing.

regional_presence.China: Sanying has a strong influence in China and is recognized by high-end foreign users.
